title: Cutting Ribbons
goal: Cut at least k equal-length ribbon pieces while maximizing their integer length.
strategy: At a candidate length, each ribbon supplies its floor-divided piece count. Feasibility decreases with larger cuts, allowing binary search with zero as the impossible result.
